items.title: UAV LiDAR Survey
items.intro: A dependable picture of the ground, even where the ground is hard to reach.
items.description: Dense point clouds penetrating steep slopes and heavy vegetation to produce true bare-earth terrain models.

items.title: Drone Photogrammetry
items.intro: High-resolution orthomosaics and visual terrain records for site planning.
items.description: Sub-centimeter aerial imagery tied to survey-grade ground control for engineering and cadastral requirements.

items.title: Engineering Survey
items.intro: Precise dimensional control and as-built verification for heavy infrastructure.
items.description: Millimeter-level alignments for tunnels, bridges, highways, and industrial structures with complete audit trails.

items.title: GNSS & Total Station Survey
items.intro: Geodetic framework establishment and tight network adjustments across complex terrain.
items.description: Static and kinematic GNSS baseline measurements tied to national datum and global reference frames.

items.title: Mobile Mapping
items.intro: High-speed road, railway, and corridor laser scanning at highway speeds.
items.description: Vehicle-mounted multi-camera LiDAR capture providing asset inventories and streetscape point clouds.

items.title: Hydrographic Survey
items.intro: Bathymetric mapping and riverbed cross-sections for hydropower and water resources.
items.description: Single-beam and multibeam sonar profiling coupled with RTK GNSS for reservoir volume calculations and river morphology.

items.title: Spatial Database & GIS Solutions
items.intro: Centralized enterprise spatial databases and spatial analytics infrastructure.
items.description: Cloud and on-premise PostGIS, Oracle Spatial, and ArcGIS Enterprise architectures.

items.title: Enterprise GIS Deployment

items.title: Spatial Data Processing

items.title: Geotechnical Displacement Monitoring
